description: Nothing to add: AGRIBALYSE is a process export, so its flows are the rows its processes exchange and there is no second file shipping rows the adapter cannot see. What this file holds is the refusal of one whole compartment: the 43 `Final waste flows` rows, extracted like every other compartment and refused here on the record (#189), so that a consumer counting ADEME's rows against the associations sees a decision rather than an oversight -- the #115 lesson. `excluded_rows_are_in_the_fetch` is set for Stepwise's reason: the fetch produces these rows on every run, and their removal at load is the ordinary path, not news.

excluded.name: Aluminium waste
excluded.reason: A SimaPro `Final waste flows` row is an accounting device -- waste leaving the product system boundary -- not an exchange with the environment, and the consensus context vocabulary has no waste compartment for it to land in (EF 3.1, BAFU, Stepwise and ecoinvent's biosphere ship none). The 43 rows of the compartment are refused together; see #189 for the decision and the two alternatives it weighed.
excluded.comment: One of the 43 `Final waste flows` rows refused together under #189, option 1 (refuse and record). Enumerated from AGB32_final.CSV (SimaPro 9.6.0.1 export, 20,440 processes) on 2026-09-01: 43 distinct flows over 4,640 exchange rows, every one with a trailing substance block, 41 in kilograms and the two nuclear-waste rows in cubic metres, none carrying a registry number, none ever minted a consensus flow (verified against the first five-list build, b0b8d76). The uuid is the adapter's own derivation over (name, compartment, subcompartment, unit), so the record names exactly the row the fetch produces.
